angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 549,603 km at 199.71 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0073 +/- 0.0130 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 199.71 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.79 +/- 0.008 solar radii from McGruder et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract): 549,603 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.854 +/- 0.027 solar masses from McGruder et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5438 +/- 50 K from McGruder et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McGruder et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-6 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-6.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.574, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-6 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.15 dex, from McGruder et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-6 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.29675, from Barstow et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017ApJ...834...50B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-6 (pscomppars): age 3.2 Gyr, from McGruder et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-6 (pscomppars): rotation period 28.28 d, from McGruder et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJ...944L..56M/abstract)
